## Checklist

- [ ] Lint and format pass locally (`ruff check .` / `ruff format --check .`)

- [ ] Public symbols have docstrings and type hints
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `## [Unreleased]`
- [ ] Documentation updated where relevant
